meta.title: Images
meta.subtitle: Convert, compress, resize, remove backgrounds and crop images
meta.pageSubtitle: Process images directly in your browser

converter.title: Converter
converter.icoHint: ICO: 16 × 16, 32 × 32 and 48 × 48 px in one file. Aspect ratio and transparency are preserved. The largest image is selected when reading ICO.

crop.title: Crop
crop.aspectHint: Enter whole numbers from 1 to 1000 for both sides.
crop.transformHint: Zoom changes the preview only. Rotation refits the frame within the image using the selected aspect ratio.

outputErrors.settings: Enter a positive whole-number size in pixels.
outputErrors.pixels: Output exceeds 16 MP or 16,384 px per side.

errors.unsupported: Choose JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF for cropping. ICO and GIF are not supported.
errors.pixels: Image exceeds 16 MP or 16,384 px per side.

uploadLimits: Up to 100 files · 50 MiB per file · 500 MiB total

background.title: Remove background
background.shortHint: For illustrations with solid backgrounds. Export as transparent PNG or WebP.
background.hint: Connected Background removes an area starting from the selected point, preserving isolated regions of the same color. All Matching Colors removes similar colors throughout the image. Complex backgrounds and photos may produce imperfect results.
background.pickHint: Enable the eyedropper and select the background. Use arrow keys to move the point.
background.pickingHint: Click the background to pick a color. Drag to pan the image. Press Esc to disable the eyedropper.
background.previewHint: 100% fits the image. Drag to pan when zoomed in. Export preserves the original resolution.

resize.title: Resize
resize.fitHint: Preserves each image's aspect ratio. Dimensions are based on the first file.
resize.exactHint: All images get the same dimensions. Aspect ratios may change.
resize.switchHint: Switching modes recalculates dimensions based on the first image.
resize.limits: Output: 1–16,384 px per side, up to 16 MP. Scale: 0.1–1000%.

compression.title: Compression
compression.shortHint: Lower quality usually means smaller files. PNG stays lossless.
compression.qualityHint: Lower quality generally means a smaller file. Applies to JPG, WebP, and AVIF. Format and resolution remain unchanged.
compression.pngHint: PNG is compressed losslessly; the quality setting does not apply. File size may increase.

switchMode.question: Switch modes? Uploaded files, settings and results in the current mode will be discarded. Any processing in progress will be cancelled.

limits: Up to 100 files, 50 MiB per file, 500 MiB total. Up to 16 MP and 16,384 px per side. Metadata are not preserved.

errors.unsupported: Unsupported format. Choose JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or ICO
errors.compressionUnsupported: Choose JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF for compression. ICO and GIF are not supported
errors.resizeUnsupported: Choose JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF for resizing. ICO and GIF are not supported
errors.resizeSettings: Enter positive integer width and height, or a scale from 0.1 to 1000%
errors.pixels: The original or output image exceeds 16 MP or 16,384 px per side
errors.decode: Could not read the image. The file may be damaged
